title: Card, nonmodal double-faced layout
description: A file in data/oracle/card/nonmodal_double_faced/. A card with two faces where neither face is chosen at casting: the front runs while the card is one object, and the back runs after it transforms (CR 709). The front and the back each hold their own characteristics.

layout.description: The id of this card's layout in data/oracle/card/component/layout.json. A layout fixes which values a card has and how its faces are arranged. The folder the card sits in is named after it.

history.description: Records of official corrections to this card. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.
